segments.title: Locked chat? 3 things it won't hide
segments.say: Locked your ChatGPT chat? Three things it still doesn't hide.

segments.title: 1. Memory stays
segments.say: One: anything ChatGPT remembered before you locked it stays remembered.

segments.title: 2. Shared links still work
segments.say: Two: an old shared link keeps working. Delete the link separately.

segments.title: 3. It can still be copied
segments.say: Three: anyone who can open the chat can still copy it.

segments.title: Bonus: your PIN
segments.say: Bonus: changing your PIN keeps locked chats. Resetting a forgotten PIN deletes them for good.
Save this before you lock your next chat, and follow for honest AI tips.
